explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/841: BPZ24 proved t_n ≫ (log log n)^{6/5}(log log log n)^{−1/5} for all non-square n. The statement gives ∃ C > 0 such that, for all large non-square n, C·(log log n)^{6/5}(log log log n)^{−1/5} ≤ t n. Restricting to large n is the usual reading of ≫ here, since the iterated logs degenerate for small n. Faithful.
